format.name: agent-journal/events-jsonl
format.record_rule: a line whose top-level member 'declaration' is an object is a declaration record; every other line is an OCSF execution event carrying class_uid
format.upstream_validation: the pinned upstream OCSF validator is run on execution records only (every line without a top-level 'declaration' member); declaration records are validated by the reader against declaration_definitions
format.lifecycle: declarations are append-only and written before the first event that references them; a 'recording' declaration marks finalization (COMPLETED or INTERRUPTED); a file without one is an open prefix, or the writer failed, which only the ancillary run.json can state
format.ancillary: run.json beside this file is an index and summary (final hash, counts, failure detail, extension source, semantic contract, mapping audit); it is not needed to interpret this file and may be absent

extension.name: agentic_cli
extension.reader_rule: resolve class names through this table; refuse a file whose pinned uid/class table differs from the reader's compiled schema

time_policy.time: source-reported time when the record has one (time_basis 1); else the latest preceding reported time in the same artifact, else capture start (time_basis 2); metadata.original_time holds the source text verbatim; ordering is journal.sequence, never time
time_policy.severity_id: always 0 Unknown: Journal convention, not a vendor assertion

schema.definition_policy: each class, object and scalar type is declared before the first event that uses it: extension-defined classes and objects complete; core objects with their required attributes plus those the events use, amended by a later definition record when an event uses a further attribute; profile-only attributes of profiles the events do not enable omitted

cli.name: Codex CLI

launch_settings.command: replay of the sanitized live stream (original: codex exec --json --skip-git-repo-check -s read-only ...)
launch_settings.original_route: LIVE: CliCapture launch, raw stdout, independent byte copy

synthetic.label: SANITIZED REAL LIVE RECORDING (Codex CLI 0.160.1, web search (-c web_search=live) started and completed), replayed through the writer to produce this package; the live package itself is private steward evidence

written_by.name: journal-ocsf-writer OcsfRunWriter
written_by.mode: incremental: declarations and events appended as native records arrived; no batch conversion or re-layout

applies_to.selection: route stdout; the stream reports no version: the capture discovers it once per run with codex --version (RULE-8) and declares the basis

embedded.executor: journal-ocsf-writer CodexStreamMapper (direct Java); one record at a time; no cross-record state

time_policy.reported: none: the exec stream carries no timestamps

rules.owner: response_uid = item.id (stream-scoped id such as item_0; it does not occur in the rollout, R13-08)

rules.content: one block: block_kind 2 Thought, reasoning_form_id 2 Summary (codex.stream.reasoning_summary.v1: the processor writes the reasoning summary parts joined by newlines; raw reasoning content is not projected)

attribution.outcome: 3 Unattributed: a standalone operation; the stream reports no wrapping call id

rules.status: item.completed: status_id 1/2 from item.status completed/failed (Reported); declined: status_id 99 with status "Declined" (Reported; not a permission decision: none is reported); item.started: 0 Unknown, basis 1 (reported in_progress)
rules.operation: uid = item.id (identity_basis 2 stream-local); command_line = item.command exactly (never parsed into argv); reported_state, exit_code, stdout = aggregated_output

rules.request: tool_name = item.tool, tool_namespace = item.server, arguments = item.arguments exactly, reported_state = item.status

rules.result: tool_result.data = item.result.content (null when result has none), structured_result = item.result.structured_content when not null, error_reported = item.status failed; status_id 1/2 from item.status (Reported); item.error stays in data

rules.request: only the declared duplicate form (item.id twice: the exec item id, then the search item's own id), recorded by a duplicate-recording parse; tool_call_uid = the first item.id; tool_name = web_search (the item type: the stream names no tool); arguments = item.action exactly; the record itself is retained verbatim by common.opaque->source_record, both ids in raw_data

rules.result: tool_result.data = item.results when present; arguments = the completed item.action; status_id 0, basis 3 (no status is reported)

rules.request: tool_name = item.tool (spawn_agent, send_input, wait, close_agent), reported_state = item.status; sender, receivers, prompt and agent states stay in data (no child-run link is made)

rules.result: no result content is reported; status_id 1/2 from item.status (Reported)

rules.request: tool_name = file_change (the item type: the stream names no tool), reported_state = item.status; the changes (path, kind) stay in data

rules.result: no result content is reported; status_id 1/2 from item.status (Reported; the processor reports a declined patch as failed)

rules.usage: usage -> scope 5 Session (the thread) status 2 Final for this run (rule codex.stream.thread_usage.v2: ThreadTokenUsage.total, the thread's cumulative usage at this turn's completion; not per turn); measurement_status_id 1 Measured when any component is non-zero, 2 Possibly default when all are zero (codex.stream.usage_measurement.v1: the emitter writes Usage::default() when no update arrived)

rules.session: rule codex.stream.thread_started->session: thread.started.thread_id becomes session_uid on every later event of this source (the stream states its session identity once); the record stays retained whole

rules.selector: any line that is blank, not UTF-8, not one JSON object under strict duplicate-key parsing, or cut off by the end of the source
rules.residual: raw_data (text) or raw_bytes_b64 (bytes); parse_status_id 5 Incomplete at source end when the source ended mid-record

rules.selector: a parsed record whose mapper threw
rules.residual: whole record in data; basis names the exception. A defect of the writer is visible, never a lost record
